title: fix(currentRefinements): correctly show and allow for refining escaped values
body:
<!--
  Thanks for submitting a pull request!
  Please provide enough information so that others can review your pull request.
-->

**Summary**

Escaped values, like `-10` in toggleRefinement or `"-anything"` in refinementList/menu/hierarchicalMenu show up correctly (unescaped/non-escaped), however clicking on the refinement item didn't do anything, as it was also trying to remove the non-existing non-escaped value.

<!--
  Explain the **motivation** for making this change.
  What existing problem does the pull request solve?
  Are there any linked issues?
-->

**Result**

This is fixed by introducing an escaped and non-escaped version of each relevant filter type and using that for the actual value of the refinement

I've also slightly refactored getRefinements and its tests, as they still showed some pre-jest signs.
